```{=html}
<style>
.w045 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w045 .w045-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w045 .w045-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w045 .w045-row.w045-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w045 .w045-row.w045-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w045 .w045-st { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w045 .w045-tf {
  flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); font-weight: 600;
}
.w045 .w045-tf.w045-sel { border-color: #d81e2e; outline: 2px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 1px; }
.w045 .w045-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w045 button.w045-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w045 .w045-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w045 .w045-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w045 .w045-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w045 .w045-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w045 iw" id="w045">
  <div class="w045-rows" aria-label="statements to judge"></div>
  <div class="w045-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w045-btn w045-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w045-btn w045-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w045-btn w045-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w045-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w045-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w045');
  const rowsBox = root.querySelector('.w045-rows');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w045-msg');
  const STATEMENTS = [
    ['Under Zero Trust, a request is trusted because it comes from inside the network.', 'f'],
    ['Zero Trust assumes that a breach has happened or will happen.', 't'],
    ['In the castle-and-moat model, an attacker who breached the perimeter could move freely inside.', 't'],
    ['A bastion host is a single hardened, closely watched machine that is the only entry point for administration.', 't'],
    ['In the NIST reference model, the policy enforcement point decides and the policy decision point enforces.', 'f'],
    ['A cloud tenant can draw a physical perimeter around its own hardware.', 'f']
  ];
  function clearMarks() {
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(r => r.classList.remove('w045-right', 'w045-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w045-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function makeRow(text, answer) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w045-row';
    row.dataset.a = answer;
    const st = document.createElement('div');
    st.className = 'w045-st'; st.textContent = text;
    row.appendChild(st);
    ['t', 'f'].forEach(v => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'w045-tf'; b.dataset.v = v;
      b.textContent = v === 't' ? 'True' : 'False';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        row.querySelectorAll('.w045-tf').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('w045-sel'));
        b.classList.add('w045-sel');
        clearMarks();
      });
      row.appendChild(b);
    });
    return row;
  }
  root.querySelector('.w045-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, open = 0;
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(row => {
      row.classList.remove('w045-right', 'w045-wrong');
      const sel = row.querySelector('.w045-tf.w045-sel');
      if (!sel) { open++; return; }
      if (sel.dataset.v === row.dataset.a) { row.classList.add('w045-right'); right++; }
      else { row.classList.add('w045-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === STATEMENTS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — least privilege, verify explicitly, assume breach.'; msg.className = 'w045-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (open > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + open + ' statement(s) not yet judged.'; msg.className = 'w045-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red statements are judged wrongly' + (open ? ', and ' + open + ' still open' : '') + '.'; msg.className = 'w045-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w045-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w045-tf').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w045-sel'));
    clearMarks();
  });
  root.querySelector('.w045-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(row => {
      row.classList.remove('w045-right', 'w045-wrong');
      row.querySelectorAll('.w045-tf').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle('w045-sel', b.dataset.v === row.dataset.a);
      });
      row.classList.add('w045-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w045-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  STATEMENTS.forEach(s => rowsBox.appendChild(makeRow(s[0], s[1])));
})();
</script>
```
